turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of the ad budget used (budget pacing), so I can't give that share; the closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR), 6,270.00 EUR spent from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, and Remaining budget (EUR), 4,130.00 EUR left at the end of September 2026 (each campaign's last snapshot in the month, added up). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
